summary: Correct the possessive person: Our cat → My cat
rationale: The quoted qaṭunayḏi has the first-person singular possessive -ayḏi, “my”, not the first-person plural possessive. Thus the English Our mismatches the Turoyo person. The same batch’s barṯ-ayḏi and naʕimáyḏi are translated “meiner Tochter” and “meiner Kinder”. No change to the Turoyo spelling is proposed.

summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 1 in Preterit (MAC NE Mother Mary saves Sultan’s son/32)

data.turoyo: Mbállalli, ŭ naqqa ṭayərno mi+gamiye, čīkno bu+baḥar. Omaṇṇo, ‘Ay yade!’, naqqa i+Ndaṯalo aṯyo, lqə́flali, ṭʕə́ḷḷali.
data.translation: They carried me away, and all of a sudden (lit. ‘at once’) I flew from the boat, I plunged into the sea. I say, “Hey, mummy!” at once the Theotokos came, she snatched me, she carried me.
data.ref: MAC NE Mother Mary saves Sultan’s son/32

rationale: Thin new Preterit cell; independent telling with explicit 1sg patient suffix and water context.

data.turoyo: I naqqa d ḥa d mḥaləq u pallo, d a ḥrene d ləqfile, hawo koyotu, yaʕni haw koqodər d məštaʕe bi dawrayo.
data.translation: Wenn einer das Flugholz schleudert, und die anderen es fangen, so "setzt sich" der Schleuderer "hin", d. h. er kann in dieser Runde nicht mehr Mitspielen.

rationale: Thin Infectum I.1; suffixal game-piece object and explicit catching consequence.

data.turoyo: W iḏa d lo ləqfile, gmaydile me ʕal i arʕo w gəmḥalqile l si ḥəlle.
data.translation: Und wenn sie es nicht fangen, nehmen sie es von der Erde auf und werfen es zur Freistatt zurück.

rationale: Completes Infectum I.1 to five; failed aerial catch contrasts with retrieving the piece from the ground.

rationale: The existing physical catching meaning also applies to a boy taken up after falling/plunging into the sea in two independently worded tellings. Remove the categorical air-only restriction without introducing a save sense: rescue is expressed by maxlaṣla/ṭʕəḷḷali or context.

summary: The new Preterit is lqəf- with feminine agent -la; lqə́flali overtly adds the affected boy as 1sg suffix. This is not lqf 2 report to someone.
94/375 already supplies an Infectum example. Two additional game passages fill that cell to five; /387 repeats its morphology and meaning with a longer score rule.

Airborne catching is explicit in the game context and inherited gloss, but not in the boy’s catching after plunging into water. The gloss is broadened conservatively, not split into a supernatural-rescue sense.
In the two Mary-rescue tellings, is the child intercepted while airborne or taken from the sea? This determines how broadly the capture meaning extends beyond the air-only gloss.
A human is caught/taken up in a sea-rescue narrative. Catching remains the lexical action; the text does not explicitly require airborne interception.

evidence.cite: MAC NE Mother Mary saves Sultan’s son/32
